ui.nav.label: Categories
ui.daily.photocraft.title: Photoshop habits, no subscription
ui.daily.photocraft.text: PhotoCraft opens layered PSD files, handles adjustment layers and layer styles, and works offline. The menus and shortcuts feel familiar, and the code is open.
ui.daily.localsend.title: AirDrop between any devices
ui.daily.localsend.text: LocalSend moves files and text over your local network, phone to laptop and back, on any system. No internet or account needed, and transfers are encrypted.
ui.daily.whispercpp.title: Speech to text, without the cloud
ui.daily.whispercpp.text: whisper.cpp turns audio and video into text in dozens of languages right on your computer. It can also listen to a microphone and transcribe in real time.
ui.daily.godot.title: Make your own game, royalty-free
ui.daily.godot.text: Godot is an engine with its own editor, node-based scenes and the GDScript language. Ship to desktop, mobile and the web, and the MIT license asks for nothing in return.
ui.daily.shpd.title: Just one more run
ui.daily.shpd.text: Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a turn-based roguelike in a randomly generated dungeon. The gear is different every time, and death means starting over.
ui.daily.obs.title: Record your screen and go live
ui.daily.obs.text: OBS Studio builds scenes from windows, cameras and game capture and streams to Twitch, YouTube or any RTMP service. A mixer and voice filters are built in.
ui.daily.keepassxc.title: Passwords in a file you own
ui.daily.keepassxc.text: KeePassXC keeps your passwords in an encrypted database on your own device. A generator, browser autofill and TOTP codes, with no cloud account.
ui.daily.excalidraw.title: Draw diagrams that look hand-sketched
ui.daily.excalidraw.text: Excalidraw runs in the browser, works offline and keeps your files with you. Great for architecture sketches, retros and explaining things on a call.
ui.daily.zed.title: An editor that never makes you wait
ui.daily.zed.text: Zed is written in Rust and renders its interface on the GPU, so it responds instantly even in large projects. You can edit code with a teammate in real time.
ui.daily.anki.title: Remember more, review less
ui.daily.anki.text: Anki shows hard cards more often and the ones you know less often. The FSRS scheduler cuts down on reviews, and thousands of shared decks help you get started.
ui.daily.filmcraft.title: Premiere Pro-style editing, in the open
ui.daily.filmcraft.text: FilmCraft is a non-linear video editor written in Rust with its own codecs. Three-point editing, color grading with scopes and over 90 video effects.
ui.daily.syncthing.title: Your files on every device, no cloud
ui.daily.syncthing.text: Syncthing keeps folders in sync directly between your own devices. There is no central server, and connections are encrypted.
ui.daily.luanti.title: A sandbox where you write the rules
ui.daily.luanti.text: Luanti, formerly Minetest, is a voxel engine with thousands of games and mods written in Lua. Run your own server and play with friends.
ui.daily.logseq.title: Notes where everything connects
ui.daily.logseq.text: In Logseq every thought is a block you can link to others with references and tags. Start from the daily journal, and your files stay with you as Markdown.
ui.seo.homeDesc: A storefront of free open-source apps for macOS, Windows, Linux and Android. No ads or trackers, one-click downloads straight from GitHub releases.
ui.manifest.title: Free, ad-free and open source. Every single app.

ui.collection.title: AI on your own computer
ui.collection.text: Models run locally. Your prompts and files never go to someone else's cloud.

ui.fresh.sub: Apps that released a new version in the last two weeks.
ui.adobe.title: Instead of Adobe
ui.adobe.sub: Open alternatives to Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator, InDesign, Acrobat, Premiere Pro and After Effects from Brandon Thomas's ArtCraft. Young Rust projects, versions 0.x.
ui.google.title: Instead of Google
ui.google.sub: Open replacements for Google services: browser, video, photos, maps, mail, documents and 2FA codes. No ads, and your data doesn’t go to Google.
ui.microsoft.title: Instead of Microsoft
ui.microsoft.sub: Open replacements for Office, Outlook, Teams, OneNote, OneDrive, Visio, Paint, Notepad and Copilot. Free, with no subscription and no ads.
ui.subs.title: Instead of subscriptions
ui.subs.sub: Free replacements for Notion, Figma, Miro, Zoom, Slack, 1Password, Dropbox, Evernote, Todoist, Microsoft 365, Creative Cloud and ChatGPT Plus. No monthly bills.
ui.agents.title: Works with AI agents
ui.agents.sub: These apps ship their own MCP server from their authors, so an AI agent such as Claude Code can work right inside them. How to connect is on each app page.
ui.mcp.title: Connect VibeMarket to Claude Code
ui.mcp.text: The agent finds a free replacement for a paid app, downloads the installer for your computer and checks its SHA-256. You install it yourself.
ui.mcp.other: In Claude Desktop, Cursor and other clients, use the same npx command in the MCP settings.

design.sub: Graphics, illustration and modeling without a subscription

work.name: Productivity
work.sub: Notes, documents and tasks that belong to you

privacy.name: Privacy
privacy.sub: Passwords, messages and files without middlemen

ai.name: AI
ai.sub: Models that run on your computer

games.name: Games
games.sub: Open-source strategy, racing and sandbox games

vscodium.desc: VS Code without telemetry. The same extensions and debugger.
vscodium.about: VSCodium is built from the same source code as Visual Studio Code, but without Microsoft telemetry and branding. Extensions come from the open Open VSX registry, and your settings, themes and keyboard shortcuts stay the same.
shots: The same editor, minus the telemetry
Extensions from the open Open VSX registry

neovim.desc: Vim with Lua plugins, built-in LSP and an asynchronous core.
neovim.about: Neovim builds on the ideas of Vim: an asynchronous core, configuration and plugins in Lua, a built-in LSP client and Tree-sitter for precise highlighting. It runs in the terminal and in graphical front-ends.
shots: Modal editing you know from Vim
Windows, tabs and a built-in terminal

zed.desc: A fast Rust editor with collaborative editing.
zed.about: Zed is written in Rust and renders its interface on the GPU, so it responds instantly even in large projects. It has real-time collaborative editing, a built-in terminal and language server support.
shots: Terminal and tasks in the same window

godot.desc: A game engine for 2D and 3D. No royalties, no sign-up.
godot.about: Godot is a game engine with its own editor, node-based scenes and the GDScript language. It supports C# and exports to desktop, mobile and the browser. The engine is MIT-licensed, with no royalties or subscriptions.
shots: Export to desktop, mobile and the web

tauri.desc: Lightweight desktop apps built with web tech and Rust.
tauri.about: Tauri builds desktop and mobile apps from a web interface and a Rust backend. Instead of bundling Chromium it uses the system WebView, so installers are many times smaller than with Electron.
shots: Rust backend and a one-command build
Builds for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android

lazygit.desc: Git in the terminal: commits, rebases and conflicts in one keystroke.
lazygit.about: Lazygit is a terminal UI for Git. Staging individual lines, interactive rebase, working with branches and resolving conflicts take a single keystroke instead of long commands.
shots: The whole repository on one screen

excalidraw.desc: A virtual whiteboard for hand-drawn style diagrams.
excalidraw.about: Excalidraw is a whiteboard for diagrams that look hand-drawn. It runs in the browser and supports end-to-end encrypted collaboration, PNG and SVG export, and libraries of ready-made shapes.

penpot.desc: Design and prototyping in the browser on the open SVG standard.
penpot.about: Penpot is a design and prototyping platform that runs in the browser and stores designs in open formats: SVG, CSS and HTML. You can host it on your own server, and developers get code straight from the design.
shots: Layouts and components in the browser
Code for developers straight from the design

blender.desc: Modeling, animation, simulation and editing in one package.
blender.about: Blender covers the whole 3D pipeline: modeling, sculpting, rigging, animation, simulation, rendering in Cycles and EEVEE, compositing and video editing.

krita.desc: Digital painting with lively brushes, layers and animation.
krita.about: Krita is made by artists for digital painting and illustration. Over a hundred brushes, line stabilizers, pressure-sensitive tablet support, layers, masks and frame-by-frame animation.

inkscape.desc: Vector illustrations, logos and diagrams in SVG.
inkscape.about: Inkscape is a vector editor for illustrations, logos, diagrams and print layouts. Its native format is SVG. It has Bézier curves, boolean operations and export to PDF, PNG and EPS.
shots: Export to PDF, PNG and EPS

gimp.desc: A photo editor: retouching, masks, layers and plugins.
gimp.about: GIMP is a raster editor for photo retouching, collages and image processing. Version 3 brought non-destructive filters, better color management and a new GTK3 interface.

joplin.desc: Markdown notes with end-to-end encryption and sync.
joplin.about: Joplin keeps notes and to-do lists in Markdown and syncs them through Nextcloud, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive or its own Joplin Server. End-to-end encryption is a setting away, and the web clipper saves pages from your browser.

logseq.desc: A knowledge base of linked notes and daily journals.
logseq.about: Logseq is a knowledge base made of blocks: every thought links to others through references and tags, and the daily journal is your entry point. Files are stored locally in Markdown or Org-mode.
shots: A daily journal made of blocks
A graph of links between notes

appflowy.desc: Docs, databases and kanban. Your data stays with you.
appflowy.about: AppFlowy combines documents, databases, kanban boards and a calendar. It works offline or with your own sync server, and its built-in AI can use local models.

libreoffice.desc: Documents, spreadsheets and slides. Opens Microsoft Office files.
libreoffice.about: LibreOffice is a full office suite: Writer for documents, Calc for spreadsheets, Impress for presentations, plus Draw, Base and Math. Its main format is the open ODF, and it opens and saves Microsoft Office files without converters.

superprod.desc: Tasks, a Pomodoro timer and time tracking without the cloud.
superprod.about: Super Productivity combines a to-do list, a Pomodoro timer and time tracking. Tasks can be pulled from Jira, GitHub and GitLab, and data is stored locally or synced through WebDAV and Dropbox.

anki.desc: Spaced repetition flashcards to remember things for good.
anki.about: Anki shows flashcards using spaced repetition: hard ones more often, learned ones less often. It supports images, audio, LaTeX formulas and thousands of shared decks, and the FSRS scheduler cuts down the number of reviews.
shots: Cards with images, audio and formulas

obs.desc: Screen recording and live streaming with a scene mixer.
obs.about: OBS Studio records your screen and streams live to Twitch, YouTube and any RTMP service. Scenes are built from sources: windows, cameras, game capture and images. It has a built-in audio mixer and voice filters.

jellyfin.desc: A personal media server for movies, shows and music.
jellyfin.about: Jellyfin turns a computer or NAS into your own media service: movies, shows, music and books with artwork, descriptions and resume playback on any device. No subscriptions, no cloud accounts, no data collection.
shots: A server on your computer or NAS

vlc.desc: A player that opens almost any video and audio format.
vlc.about: VLC plays almost any video and audio format without extra codecs, plus DVDs, network streams and subtitles. It can also convert files and stream them over your local network.

audacity.desc: Audio recording and editing for podcasts and music.
audacity.about: Audacity records and edits audio: multitrack editing, noise reduction, an equalizer, loudness normalization and effects. Good for podcasts, music and digitizing old recordings.
shots: Export to MP3, WAV, FLAC and OGG

handbrake.desc: A video converter with device presets and subtitles.
handbrake.about: HandBrake transcodes video to H.264, H.265, AV1 and VP9. Ready-made presets pick settings for phones, consoles and streaming, and the job queue processes dozens of files at once.
shots: A queue of dozens of files

mpv.desc: A minimalist player for the keyboard and scripts.
mpv.about: mpv is a minimalist player with no extra interface: everything is controlled with the keyboard, a config file and Lua scripts. High-quality video scaling and hardware decoding.

keepassxc.desc: A password manager with a local encrypted database.
keepassxc.about: KeePassXC keeps your passwords in an encrypted file on your device. Password generator, browser autofill through an extension, TOTP codes and SSH keys. No cloud account needed.
shots: All passwords in one encrypted file

bitwarden.desc: Passwords and passkeys on every device. You can run your own server.
bitwarden.about: Bitwarden syncs passwords, passkeys and notes across all your devices with end-to-end encryption. There are browser extensions, shared vaults for families and teams, and you can host the server yourself.
shots: Shared vaults for families and teams

signal.desc: A messenger with end-to-end encryption by default.
signal.about: Signal protects messages, calls and attachments with end-to-end encryption using the open Signal protocol. Disappearing messages, groups, video calls and minimal metadata on the servers.

syncthing.desc: Sync files directly between devices, without the cloud.
syncthing.about: Syncthing syncs folders directly between your devices, with no central server. Connections are encrypted, and devices find each other on the local network and over the internet.

localsend.desc: Send files over the local network, no internet or account needed.
localsend.about: LocalSend sends files and text between devices on the same network, like AirDrop but between any systems. No internet or account needed, and transfers are encrypted.
shots: Devices on the network are found automatically

mullvad.desc: A VPN client that needs neither email nor name.
mullvad.about: The Mullvad VPN client connects to Mullvad servers over WireGuard. Signing up needs no email or name: your account is a number, and you can even pay in cash.
shots: A secure connection in one click

ollama.desc: Run Llama, Qwen, Gemma and other models with one command.
ollama.about: Ollama downloads and runs language models locally with one command: Llama, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, Mistral and more. Its HTTP API is OpenAI-compatible, so it's easy to plug into your own programs.
shots: A model starts with one command
Chat with a model right on your computer

sdwebui.desc: Image generation and inpainting with hundreds of extensions.
sdwebui.about: Stable Diffusion web UI is a browser interface for image generation: txt2img, img2img, inpainting and upscaling. The extension catalog adds ControlNet, LoRA and hundreds of other tools.
shots: Inpainting and replacing parts of an image

comfyui.desc: Image and video generation through a node graph.
comfyui.about: ComfyUI builds image, video and audio generation out of graph nodes. Any workflow can be saved, shared and repeated, and models run locally on your GPU.
shots: A node pipeline instead of buttons

llamacpp.desc: LLM inference in C++. Fast even without a GPU.
llamacpp.about: llama.cpp runs language models in C/C++ with quantization down to a few bits, so large models fit on an ordinary laptop. It ships with an OpenAI-style API server and a simple web chat.

gpt4all.desc: Chat with local models and your documents, offline.
gpt4all.about: GPT4All is a desktop app for chatting with local models. LocalDocs answers questions about your files without sending them to the internet, and models download right inside the app.

whispercpp.desc: Speech recognition on the CPU. Offline audio transcription.
whispercpp.about: whisper.cpp is a C/C++ implementation of the Whisper speech recognition model. It transcribes audio and video in dozens of languages without the cloud, including in real time from a microphone.

mindustry.desc: Strategy about factories, conveyors and base defense.
mindustry.about: Mindustry combines factory building and tower defense: mine resources, build conveyors and production chains, and fight off waves of enemies. It has a campaign, multiplayer and a map editor.
shots: Defend the base from waves of enemies

luanti.desc: A voxel sandbox and engine for your own games (formerly Minetest).
luanti.about: Luanti, formerly Minetest, is a voxel engine and sandbox. Thousands of Lua games and mods from the built-in ContentDB catalog, your own servers and complete freedom over the game rules.
shots: Thousands of games and mods in ContentDB

stk.desc: Arcade kart racing with a story mode and online races.
stk.about: SuperTuxKart is arcade kart racing starring characters from the open-source world. Story mode, online races, arena battles and car soccer.

openttd.desc: A transport tycoon: trains, ships and logistics.
openttd.about: OpenTTD is a transport simulation based on Transport Tycoon Deluxe. Build railways, ports and bus routes, move cargo and passengers, and grow your company over decades.

shpd.desc: A pixel roguelike with tactical fights and random dungeons.
shpd.about: Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a turn-based roguelike: descend into a randomly generated dungeon, find gear and identify potions. Every run is unique, and dying means a fresh start.

wesnoth.desc: A turn-based fantasy strategy game on a hex map.
wesnoth.about: Battle for Wesnoth is a turn-based strategy game in a fantasy world. Armies move across hex maps where terrain and time of day affect the outcome of battle. Story campaigns and online multiplayer.

photocraft.desc: A Photoshop-style photo editor in Rust: layers, styles and PSD files.
photocraft.about: PhotoCraft is a photo editor written from scratch in Rust by the ArtCraft team. Its menus, panels and shortcuts will feel familiar to anyone who has used Photoshop. It opens and saves layered PSD files, supports adjustment layers and layer styles, works offline, and every action can be driven from the command line or over MCP.
shots: Layer styles: shadows, glows and strokes

lightcraft.desc: Lightroom-style non-destructive RAW editing in 32-bit color.
lightcraft.about: LightCraft is a non-destructive photo and RAW editor from ArtCraft. Edits never touch the original and are processed in 32-bit, wide-gamut color: exposure, curves, color wheels, dehaze and film grain. It runs on the desktop and in the browser.
shots: Color grading for shadows, midtones and highlights
Before and after with one key

vectorcraft.desc: Illustrator-style vector illustration, native and in the browser.
vectorcraft.about: VectorCraft is a vector illustration app from ArtCraft, written in Rust. It runs natively on macOS, Windows and Linux and in the browser via WebAssembly. Every feature is available through a command API, including for AI agents over MCP.
shots: Command API and MCP for agents

designcraft.desc: InDesign-style layout for magazines and books: IDML, PDF/X and EPUB.
designcraft.about: DesignCraft is a page layout app from ArtCraft: spreads, parent pages, threaded text frames, styles and tables. It hyphenates and justifies with the Knuth–Plass algorithm, imports and exports IDML, opens INDD files, and exports PDF/X-4, PDF/A and EPUB. No subscription, license server or telemetry.
shots: Export to PDF/X, PDF/A and EPUB

pdfcraft.desc: Acrobat-style PDF reading and editing, with no account or cloud.
pdfcraft.about: PdfCraft is a PDF reader and editor from ArtCraft. It renders complex typography, vertical Japanese and color emoji faithfully, repairs damaged files, and saves changes without touching the original bytes. No account, telemetry or cloud.
shots: No account or cloud, works offline

filmcraft.desc: Premiere Pro-style video editing: color, sound and effects.
filmcraft.about: FilmCraft is a professional non-linear video editor from ArtCraft, written in Rust together with its own codecs. A familiar timeline with three-point editing, color grading with scopes, over 90 video effects, an audio mixer and EBU R128 loudness metering.
shots: Audio mixer and EBU R128 loudness

effectcraft.desc: After Effects-style motion graphics and compositing, with Lottie.
effectcraft.about: EffectCraft is a motion graphics and compositing app from ArtCraft. Layer-based compositions, keyframes with a graph editor, 306 effects, 3D cameras and lights, expressions and a render queue. Lottie import and export are built in, and projects are stored as readable JSON.

ungoogled.desc: Chromium without Google services or background requests to them.
ungoogled.about: Ungoogled Chromium is regular Chromium with its dependency on Google web services removed. The browser makes no background requests to Google, and pre-built binaries are stripped from the source code. Google Safe Browsing is disabled as well. The interface stays familiar, and extra privacy settings are turned on with flags. Builds for macOS, Windows and Linux are made by the community.
shots: Familiar Chromium without a Google account
Privacy settings are turned on with flags

enteauth.desc: Two-factor authentication codes with end-to-end encryption.
enteauth.about: Ente Auth stores your two-factor authentication codes. Cloud backups are end-to-end encrypted, the app works offline, and you can skip the cloud and sign-up altogether. There are versions for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux, and you can view your codes in the browser too.
shots: All your 2FA codes in one place
Works offline and without an account

obtainium.desc: Android app updates straight from their releases.
obtainium.about: Obtainium installs and updates Android apps straight from their release pages and notifies you about new versions. Sources include GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, F-Droid and more. It lets you get open-source apps without Google Play and without middlemen.

heliboard.desc: An Android keyboard that works without internet access.
heliboard.about: HeliBoard is a customizable Android keyboard based on AOSP and OpenBoard. It has no internet permission, so what you type never leaves the device. Dictionaries for suggestions, themes, custom layouts, emoji search and multilingual typing.

freetube.desc: YouTube without ads or tracking, with subscriptions kept on your side.
freetube.about: FreeTube is a desktop YouTube app built with privacy in mind. Videos play without ads, and Google can’t track you with cookies and JavaScript. Subscriptions, playlists and history stay on your computer, and you can subscribe to channels without an account. It has SponsorBlock, a mini player and subscription export. The project is still in beta.

newpipe.desc: A lightweight YouTube client for Android without Google services.
newpipe.about: NewPipe is a lightweight Android app for watching YouTube, PeerTube, SoundCloud and Bandcamp. It uses no Google Play Services or proprietary libraries, so it also works on phones without them. Videos up to 4K, background listening, a popup player and local playlists. The app is in beta.

immich.desc: Photos and videos on your own server instead of someone else’s cloud.
immich.about: Immich keeps your photos and videos on your own server. The phone app backs up your shots automatically, and you can browse them on your phone or in the browser. It has shared albums, face recognition, search by objects and a map of your photos. You set up the server yourself, but your photos never go to someone else’s cloud. The developers remind you to keep backups following the 3-2-1 rule.

organicmaps.desc: Offline maps and navigation with no ads and no tracking.
organicmaps.about: Organic Maps is an offline maps and navigation app for walking, cycling and driving, built on OpenStreetMap data. It has no ads, no tracking and no data collection, and needs no registration. Voice guidance, contour lines, subway maps, fast offline search, and track import and export in KML, GPX and GeoJSON. For Android and iOS.

thunderbird.desc: Privacy-focused email, the successor to K-9 Mail on Android.
thunderbird.about: Thunderbird for Android is a privacy-focused email app based on K-9 Mail. Several email accounts in one app, with a Unified Inbox. This repository has the Android version; Thunderbird for desktop is downloaded from thunderbird.net.
shots: Several email accounts in one app

notepadpp.desc: A text and code editor for Windows, instead of Notepad.
notepadpp.about: Notepad++ is a free source code editor and a Notepad replacement for Windows. It supports many programming languages, highlights syntax and can be extended with plugins. Releases are signed with a GPG key, and the code is distributed under the GPL.

drawio.desc: Diagrams and flowcharts on your computer, free.
drawio.about: draw.io Desktop is the official desktop app of draw.io: flowcharts, network diagrams and other diagrams. It wraps the draw.io editor in Electron, and your files stay on your disk. The app is free under the GPL v3 license, with builds for macOS, Windows, including ARM, and Linux.

pinta.desc: A simple image editor in the style of Paint.NET.
pinta.about: Pinta is a simple image editor, a clone of Paint.NET 3.0. Layers, drawing tools, effects and color adjustments, easy to pick up from the first launch. It runs on Linux, Windows and macOS, and the code is open under the MIT license.

jitsi.desc: Video meetings with screen sharing, including on your own server.
jitsi.about: Jitsi Meet is a desktop app for video meetings. It works with any Jitsi Meet deployment, including your own, and supports screen sharing, remote control and an always-on-top window. End-to-end encryption is in beta. The app updates itself.

shotcut.desc: A free video editor for Windows, macOS and Linux.
shotcut.about: Shotcut is a free, open-source, cross-platform video editor. It is built on the MLT multimedia framework and FFmpeg, so it opens many formats. Timeline editing, filters, audio work and export to popular formats.

jan.desc: A ChatGPT replacement that runs on your computer.
jan.about: Jan downloads and runs language models such as Llama, Gemma and Qwen right on your computer. You can connect cloud models if you want, but everything can run locally. It has custom assistants, MCP support and a local server with an OpenAI-compatible API.
shots: Chat with a model on your computer

mattermost.desc: Team chat instead of Slack, on your own Mattermost server.
mattermost.about: Mattermost is an open-source collaboration platform, and this is its desktop app. Channels, Boards and Playbooks in dedicated tabs, desktop notifications, unread badges and several servers in one window. On first launch you enter the address of a Mattermost server: your own or your company’s.
